issues.legal_issue: Land may be assessed at the rate for an industrial purpose only when it is actually being used for that purpose, not merely intended or set apart for future use.
material_facts: The assessment charge set rates according to whether land was used for industrial, commercial, or other non-agricultural purposes.
The High Court held that land intended or set apart for industrial use could be assessed at the industrial rate even if it was not actually being used for that purpose.
issues.conclusion: The appeals were allowed and the High Court’s interpretation was set aside. Only land actually in use for an industrial purpose could be assessed at the rate specified for industrial use.
issues.legal_principle: Section 3 of the Andhra Pradesh Non-Agricultural Lands Assessment Act, 1963, uses the phrase “land is used” to describe the basis for the applicable rate; section 2(d) defines industrial purpose. A taxing statute must be strictly construed: courts must apply the language used, may not read words into it to achieve an assumed legislative purpose, and, in case of doubt, should adopt the interpretation beneficial to the taxpayer. The Court relied on Cape Brandy Syndicate v. Inland Revenue Commissioners, The State of Bombay v. Automobile and Agricultural Industries Corporation, Bombay, and The Controller of Estate Duty, Gujarat v. Shri Kantilal Trikamlal.

rule.if: tax_assessment_appeal and charge_classifies_land_by_present_use and land_not_currently_used_industrially and land_reserved_for_industrial_use

predicates.tax_assessment_appeal: A party appealed a ruling interpreting the basis for a tax assessment.
predicates.charge_classifies_land_by_present_use: The assessment charge describes categories of land by whether the land is used for specified purposes.
predicates.land_not_currently_used_industrially: The land was not actually being used for an industrial purpose.
predicates.land_reserved_for_industrial_use: The land was intended or set apart for future industrial use.
predicates.land_not_assessable_at_industrial_use_ra: Land that is not actually being used for an industrial purpose cannot be assessed at the rate for industrial use.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a tax assessment charge that classifies land by present use, land reserved for industrial use but not currently used industrially is not assessable at the industrial-use rate.
